title: liketrek/TREK
claim: liketrek/TREK — A self-hosted travel/trip planner with real-time collaboration, maps, budgets, packing lists, PWA and SSO.
hook: A self-hosted TripIt/Wanderlog — plan trips with maps, budgets and real-time collaboration on your own server.
why_good: Trip planning is stuck between clunky free tools and subscription apps that hoard your itinerary; TREK is a polished, self-hostable planner (maps, budgets, packing lists, SSO, real-time collab) — the ownership wedge a loyal travel audience actually pays for.
value: A hosted edition plus team/agency seats sold to frequent travelers, travel clubs and small agencies who want a branded, private Wanderlog without per-seat SaaS lock-in.
risk: Consumer travel is a graveyard of planners, and distribution is brutal against Google Travel and TripIt; self-host enthusiasm has to convert into a paying hosted funnel.

zh.claim: liketrek/TREK —— 自托管的旅行/行程规划器,支持实时协作、地图、预算、打包清单、PWA 与 SSO。
zh.hook: 自托管版 TripIt/Wanderlog——在自己服务器上用地图、预算和实时协作规划行程。
zh.why_good: 行程规划一直卡在「难用的免费工具」和「把行程锁死的订阅 app」之间;TREK 是一个做得很完整、可自托管的规划器(地图、预算、打包清单、SSO、实时协作)——正是忠实旅行人群愿意付费的「数据自有」切入点。
zh.value: 向高频旅行者、旅行俱乐部和小型旅行社卖托管版和团队/机构席位——他们想要带自己品牌、私有的 Wanderlog,而不被按席位 SaaS 绑死。
zh.risk: 消费级旅行规划是一片红海坟场,面对 Google Travel 和 TripIt 获客极难;自托管的热情必须转化成能付费的托管漏斗。

pick_reason: A polished, self-hostable trip planner with a clear hosted/team monetization path against subscription incumbents.
